description: Constant predictor: arithmetic mean of TRAIN measured log-solubility, applied to every VALIDATION molecule. No descriptor or GIN model.
target_column: measured log solubility in mols per litre
forbidden_target_column: ESOL predicted log solubility in mols per litre

baseline.seed_note: Deterministic; no RNG. Frozen split seed 42 is historical only and was not used to regenerate assignments.

evaluation.scale: original measured log solubility in mols per litre
evaluation.procedure: For each validation row i: y_pred = train_mean; MAE = mean(|y_pred - y_true|); RMSE = sqrt(mean((y_pred - y_true)^2)); R^2 = 1 - SS_res/SS_tot with SS_tot relative to validation mean (supplementary).
